236. Flame of Annihilation, Cruel Past (3)
The explosion instantly obscured the figures of Jin and Murakan.
Jin and Murakan had no choice but to adjust their plan. Now that Elona has stopped, it would mean the destruction of the Demon World if the two of them recklessly charged at Kelliac.
It's true that the Demon World invaded the human world, but it was a huge tragedy caused by Kelliac's brainwashing.
The Demon World without Geot is a place where people live, just like the human world. It was a homeland for billions of demons, a world existing underground.
They couldn't just stand by and watch the Demon World disappear. Above all, if they didn't properly block the explosion now, even their allies outside the battlefield would suffer tremendous damage.
This includes not only Valeria, but also the fleets of the human world that had just arrived in hell would be completely destroyed.
The debris Kelliac set off now was a major explosion unprecedented in human history. Also, it was not just a simple explosion, but a spell of the Fire God, modified by his authority.
Flame of Annihilation, the ultimate power Shinu obsessed over for a long time to overwhelm other gods before creating the Origin Stone.
That flame was now trying to burn Jin and Murakan. Only the small space between Kelliac and Elona remained unaffected by the fire.
"No, no way...."
Kelliac slowly descended toward Elona. Elona backed away, her face turned pale.
As the distance between the two narrowed, Elona's hair gradually changed. Her long hair, a symbol of the pure-blooded Gipil, was turning golden.

A surge of uncontrollable passion swirled inside her. The memories of a thousand years ago that surged like sharp fragments, the terrible experiments in the dark, the days yearning for light, and the strong desire to quickly put that diadem on her head.
These things paralyzed Elona. The old days she remembered meeting Jin and the meaning of existence she realized were merely weak emotions compared to her instinct towards that diadem.
Kelliac stood in front of Elona.
Elona was still desperately resisting her instincts.
She tried to attack Kelliac by raising her magic, and moved her legs to get away from him.
However, her magic didn't react like a dead power source, and she was already on her knees. With dazed eyes and slow, stifled breathing, Elona couldn't do anything.

"It's unfortunate, isn't it? A life where you know nothing about yourself. All the truths you've tried to obtain are false, and all the meanings you've bestowed to find yourself are nothing but empty obsessions... You're an unfortunate existence, Elona."
Don't listen, don't listen to whatever Kelliac says!

Occasionally, Murakan's distant voice came through. He and Jin were already far away from the two of them, having to block the fire of destruction, and were continuously being pushed back with each passing second.
Elona did not recognize his voice. She was just dazed, like listening to the echo of the wind rushing into a cave.
Knowing this well, Kelliac didn't worry. Instead, he confirmed once again that they hadn't given up on the demon world.
Then, this naming ceremony would not be disturbed by Jin and Murakan. It might be possible to prevent the complete destruction of the demon world with two stars, but they couldn't save Elona.

"They would want to help you. But is that really helping you? Elona, the reason your life is miserable, feeling disillusioned by destruction and killing, always wallowing in self-loathing... it's because you don't know what you are. And they can't tell you that."
Kelliac brought the crown of laurels closer to Elona's head. Her hair was now shining brilliantly like the sun.
"So now would be a good time to take a moment to look at yourself."
Soon, the crown of laurels touched Elona's head.
The crown moved like a snake and wrapped around Elona's head. Then it began to spin above her head.
It was then that Elona first opened her eyes again.
Her pupils were shattering. The fragments of her broken pupils filled her eyeballs, looking like a small Milky Way.
At the same time, Elona began to fall into her own memories.
The existence that can be called the prototype of Elona Jipil was discovered by humans about 2,500 years ago.
At that time, the name Lukandel did not yet exist, and the mages of Jipil, w
ho received the special love of the gods, held the power of the world alone for a long time.
Reginald Jipil.
The fourth head of the Jipil family, he discovered a historic site hidden underground in a kingdom of the Lutero Federation.
A land filled with the green light of life, a mysterious land that, for complete magical bodies, just being on that land would heal any disease or injury.
In that place, one could not feel hunger, and no matter how much power was used, fatigue did not creep in.

As soon as Reginald felt the power of the land, he designated it as the 'sacred place' of Jipil. He allowed only the head of the family and his closest associates to enter the sanctuary, and the secret is still kept to this day.
"This place is not the land created by the existing gods, Bichelin."
At Reginald's words, Bichelin nodded. At the time, Bichelin was the vice head of Jipel and the contractor of Meljaire.
"No god we know could create such a perfect land. Not even Meljaire, who I contracted with, and even
Shinnu, whom we serve as our main god."
"I do not intend to blaspheme the gods. We are oddly loved by the gods and rule the world."
But on the other hand, the fact that Jipel ruled the world with the power of contracts with the gods also meant being slaves to the gods.
It has been Reginald's long-held wish to get out of the control of the gods.

That was why he began to obsess over relics and artifacts of the past to find the secrets of the world. So, it was no coincidence that Reginald found the sanctuary in the kingdom's underground, it was a result that Jipel invested the most manpower and time at the time.
In the sanctuary, you cannot hear the voice of the god. The gods cannot intervene in this land.
Also, the gods have never mentioned the sanctuary, and often seemed to have no idea about the existence of the sanctuary.
That fact came to Reginald like fate. If he used this unknown relic well, Jipel might not be a family loved by the god but could become the god itself.
"In my opinion, this place is the remnant of some giant entity that existed in the beginning. The god of the gods, the creator of the world. It must be the trace of such an existence."
"The land of the Creator...."
"Those who have not seen this land directly would think it's a ridiculous story. But can't you and I feel it now, Bichelin? That this land is the territory of a more transcendental being."
"Yes, brother. There are too many inexplicable things if not."
"We will study this land and become the real rulers of the world. The Creator led us, we are the ones who can complete the world beyond the gods."
The conversation between Reginald and Bichelin.
The reason Elorna remembers their voices accurately is no different. She was the tree that stood tall in the sanctuary at that time.

At that time, she did not understand the language of humans, but she could remember. Since she was in an incomprehensibly long solitude, it sounded endlessly sweet even if she did not understand the meaning.
She wanted to have a conversation with them.
That was the first desire Elorna had. She waited every day for Reginald and Bichelin to visit the sanctuary, and from then on, waiting turned into pain.
Even a day or two began to be hard for her, who had easily spent time for over a thousand or ten thousand years.
"Brother! Brother...! Look at this, the holy water is splitting in half!"
"What's this!"
"Something from the holy water... a, a person!?"
Elona had the power to transform her desires into reality.
She unconsciously sought a form more suited for activity than a tree, and that form resembled humans, like Reginald and Bichelin, whom she waited for every day.
"My, my Creator!"

The figure that first emerged from the tree was what people now know as Elona Ziphil. She closely resembled Bichelin, who stuttered more words, but her hair shone like the sun and small galaxies flowed in her eyes.
"My Creator!"
Reginald and Bichelin bowed down deeply, showing reverence to Elona. At that moment, Elona was realizing that the world she had dreamed of was different from the one she was facing.
The human breath she first felt after coming out of the tree.
Their odor, their appearances, their clothes, their attitudes, their expressions, all provoked a sense of discomfort that she could not even imagine.
Like facing bugs wriggling in a bucket, Elona shuddered. The bowed siblings could not see Elona's expression then.
"Ugh... Ew."
She simply showed her disgust by swinging her hand once.
Then the magic of the sanctuary gathered and instantly formed a sharp wind, and Bichelin was swept away and disappeared without a trace.
Bichelin, who first noticed Elona's change, met her death without even getting a proper look at her face.
"Bi, Bichelin!"
Elona felt no particular emotion at the death of the owner of the voice that had been so sweet.
She simply wanted these filthy beings to disappear from her sight. However, once she had seen something dirty, she intuitively knew that she could never go back to the way she was before.
So, from that point on, Elona had only one desire.
To remove all the unpleasant things in the world.
"Wh... what is this. Creator, we vowed to serve you! Why are you doing this!"
Elona did not answer and tried to kill Reginald with another wave of her hand.
However, unlike Bichelin, Reginald managed to take a defensive stance in his despair, and at that time, he was the strongest human in existence.
He handled Elona's simple and immense attack with his skills and battle experience and managed to escape.
When he escaped the sanctuary and returned to his clan, Reginald was missing an arm and the family's staff. The kingdom where the sanctuary was found had perished.
That was the first meeting of Elona and Ziphil.
